reproduction_target: 3D genome (Hi-C) analysis of the wheat pathogen Zymoseptoria tritici IPO323: wet-lab Proximo Hi-C library prep + Illumina sequencing, followed by a computational pipeline (read trimming/QC, mapping, contact-matrix construction/ICE-correction, contact-probability decay, A/B compartmentalization, TAD calling, motif/feature enrichment, plus integration of public RNA-seq/ChIP-seq/WGBS datasets for expression and epigenetic profiling).
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool preserved from Stage-1, now re-scored against actual repo shell/Python/Rmd scripts (github.com/lorraincecile/Hi-C_Ztritici_IPO323, dirs ChIPseq/, Hi-C_analyses/, RNAseq/; HiCExplorer/ is a git submodule pinning the HiCExplorer tool source at commit c1e9e92). Stage-2 code corrections: (i) C3 is `bwa mem` (module load bwa, no version) in Hi-C_analyses/Fq_to_bam_HiC.sh, NOT bwa-mem2 as inferred from prose at Stage-1 — label corrected, version stays floating; (ii) versions in this pipeline are supplied via HPC Lmod `module load tool/VERSION` lines, not a portable lockfile. Code reveals exact module pins that Stage-1 prose had left floating: STAR (star/2.7.10b) and Bowtie2 (bowtie2/2.5.1-u2j3omo) — both promoted floating→exact-pin (NI→RI). Additional sub-tool pins found (not separate steps): samtools/1.16.1, bedtools2/2.31.0, fastx-toolkit/0.0.14, python/3.11.6, gcc/12.2.0. HiCExplorer runs from an unpinned conda env named 'hicexplorer' (source miniconda_hic/bin/activate hicexplorer) — no exported lock, stays floating. TEtranscripts, Allo, cooler/cooltools, Bismark, DESeq2/topGO/EnrichedHeatmap (R libs, no sessionInfo/renv) carry NO version pin in code and stay floating. Several prose-declared tools (HiCUP-0.9.2, Circos-0.69, R 4.4.1, MEME/XSTREME, Bismark) have NO corresponding versioned script in the public repo; their pins remain prose-only. SECURITY NOTE (out-of-rubric): the repo commits a private SSH key (Hi-C_analyses/id_ed25519) — flagged for the authors, not a scoring axis.

steps.label: Trimmomatic 0.39 (module load trimmomatic/0.39) — Hi-C/ChIP/RNA read filtering/trimming (explicit ILLUMINACLIP/LEADING/TRAILING/SLIDINGWINDOW/MINLEN in ChIPseq/00_trimmomatic.sh, RNAseq/00_trimmomatic.sh, Hi-C_analyses/Fq_to_bam_HiC.sh)
HiCUP-0.9.2 — Hi-C dataset quality evaluation (version prose-only; no HiCUP script in repo — hicup.bam files appear only as inputs to hicBuildMatrix_H5.sh)

bwa mem (module load bwa, NO version) — mapping Hi-C reads to Z. tritici IPO323 / IR01_26b reference; explicit -A1 -B4 -E50 -L0 (Hi-C_analyses/Fq_to_bam_HiC.sh). CORRECTED from Stage-1 'bwa-mem2': code uses classic bwa mem

HiCExplorer suite — hicBuildMatrix (multi-enzyme in-silico digest via committed IPO323_restrictionCutFile_*.bed; --restrictionSequence/--danglingSequence/--binSize explicit), hicCorrectMatrix (ICE), hicFindTADs (run from unpinned conda env 'hicexplorer'; Hi-C_analyses/hicBuildMatrix_CL.sh/_H5.sh)
Circos-0.69 — interaction link plots (links prepared by Hi-C_analyses/00.extractLinks_IPO323.py; version prose-only, no Circos invocation script with version in repo)
cooltools / cooler — .cool conversion, contact-probability decay, A/B compartments (import cooler in Hi-C_analyses/00.extractLinks_IPO323.py; no version pin, no lockfile)
R 4.4.1 glm (+ AER dispersiontest) — log-transformed Poisson regression of chromosome loss vs normalized interaction strength (R version prose-only; Rmd files carry no sessionInfo/renv pin)
ggplot2 — visualization of observed vs predicted chromosome loss (no version pinned)
topGO runGOEnrichment — GO term enrichment with FDR correction (no version pinned; no dedicated script located in repo)
MEME suite — XSTREME (TAD-boundary motif discovery) + Tomtom vs JASPAR (default parameters, no version pinned; no MEME script in repo, JASPAR DB not pinned in code)
EnrichedHeatmap (R) — distribution of genes/TEs/RIP/histone marks/5mC across TADs/boundaries (Hi-C_analyses/EnrichedHeatmap.Rmd: libraries loaded, no version pins; explicit extend/w/mean_mode params)

STAR 2.7.10b (module load star/2.7.10b) — RNA-seq alignment to IPO323 with multimapping (--outFilterMultimapNmax 200 --winAnchorMultimapNmax 200 explicit; RNAseq/01_STAR.sh). PROMOTED: version pinned in code (was floating at Stage-1)
TEtranscripts — multimapper reassignment / gene + TE quantification (--mode multi, explicit GTF/TE; RNAseq/02_TEtransripts.sh has NO module load / version for TEtranscripts)
DESeq2 — differential expression (RNAseq/03_Log2Fold.Rmd: library(DESeq2), DESeqDataSetFromMatrix/DESeq; no version pin)

Bowtie2 2.5.1 (module load bowtie2/2.5.1-u2j3omo) — ChIP-seq mapping to IPO323 (-k 25 --no-mixed --no-discordant explicit; ChIPseq/01_bowtie2.allo.sh). PROMOTED: version pinned in code (was floating at Stage-1)
Allo — multimapping read reassignment in repeat-rich regions (source ~/packages/allo/bin/activate venv, -seq pe; no version pinned; ChIPseq/01_bowtie2.allo.sh)

Picard 2.26.2 (module load picard/2.26.2) — MarkDuplicates + samtools MAPQ<30 filter for ChIP-seq (VALIDATION_STRINGENCY=LENIENT; ChIPseq/03_picard.deduplicate.sh, 02_sort.index.bam.sh bam_quality=30)
Bismark — WGBS mapping/dedup/methylation_extractor (CG/CHG/CHH, >=4 reads, >50%) (no version pinned; NO WGBS/Bismark script present in the public repo — prose-only)
Custom Python linear/nested model — TAD co-expression (Hi-C_analyses/TAD-TAD.py, 00.HI-TADs.py: pandas/numpy/scipy/pybedtools/seaborn; no Python/library version pinned, hardcoded local /Users path)
RIP composite index — custom 1 kb sliding-window RIP-like signature (method per Lorrain et al. 2021; no version/tool pin, no dedicated script located)
